name: wopee-mcp
description: AI-powered autonomous testing for web apps through Wopee.io.
longDescription: Wopee MCP connects MCP-compatible AI agents to Wopee.io so teams can dispatch web app analysis crawls, generate testing artifacts, run AI agent tests, and fetch execution results directly from their MCP client. It supports autonomous testing workflows for web applications, including suite management, generated user stories and test cases, Playwright code artifacts, and project test results.
capabilities: Dispatch autonomous analysis and crawling suites for web applications
Create blank suites for manual test configuration
Generate app context, user stories, test cases, test steps, and Playwright code artifacts
Fetch and update generated testing artifacts
Dispatch AI agent tests for selected suites
Fetch executed test cases and coordinate testing updates through project chat
Create GitHub issues from discovered test failures when GitHub integration is configured

tools.name: wopee_fetch_analysis_suites
tools.description: Fetch all analysis suites for the configured Wopee project

tools.name: wopee_dispatch_analysis
tools.description: Create and dispatch a new analysis or crawling suite, or rerun an existing suite

tools.name: wopee_create_blank_suite
tools.description: Create an empty analysis suite for manual configuration

tools.name: wopee_generate_artifact
tools.description: Generate testing artifacts such as app context, user stories, test cases, test steps, and reusable test assets

tools.name: wopee_fetch_artifact
tools.description: Fetch generated artifacts, including app context, user stories, Playwright code, and project context

tools.name: wopee_update_artifact
tools.description: Update generated testing artifacts for a suite

tools.name: wopee_dispatch_agent
tools.description: Dispatch AI agent tests for a suite

tools.name: wopee_fetch_executed_test_cases
tools.description: Fetch executed test cases and their results

tools.name: wopee_send_chat_message
tools.description: Send status updates or informational messages to the current project's chat room

tools.name: wopee_read_chat_history
tools.description: Read recent messages from the current project's chat room

tools.name: wopee_create_github_issue
tools.description: Create a GitHub issue in the project's connected repository for bugs, test failures, or action items

features: Visual analysis crawls and generated testing artifacts
AI agent test dispatch from MCP clients
Project chat updates and history access
GitHub issue creation for connected repositories
Project status and test result access
Corporate proxy and custom certificate support
